description: This file defines the Transaction model class within the OpenCart system, handling customer transaction data such as addition, deletion, retrieval, and aggregation of transaction records in the database.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Model class for managing customer transactions within the OpenCart framework, providing methods to create, delete, retrieve, and summarize transaction data.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record in the database for a specific customer and order, including description and amount.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes transaction records for a specific customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transaction records associated with a specific order ID where the amount is negative.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transaction records for a customer, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transaction records associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of transaction amounts for a customer.
